content: In sub - state COMM_FULL_COM_READY_SLEEP and configuration parameter ComMNmVariant=LIGHT (see ECUC_ComM_00568 ) , this ComMChannel is referenced by a PNC and the timer for ComMNmLightTimeout (see ECUC_ComM_00606 ) has expired, the ComM channel state machine shall switch to state COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION as soon as all referencing PNCs resi de in COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION .
